deviceId.description: Device identifier of the AP or switch, including the parent switch record for a Virtual Chassis.

memberMac.description: Optional Virtual Chassis member MAC, in compact, colon-separated, or hyphen-separated form. Switch-only; omission selects the master switch.

durationMinutes.description: Switch-only LED blinking duration in whole minutes. Omission uses 5 minutes for switches. AP locating is persistent and does not accept a duration.

FunctionInput_juniper_mist_locatedevice.description: Site and device to identify physically, with optional switch duration and Virtual Chassis member selection.

siteId.description: Site to which the locate request was addressed.

deviceId.description: Device to which the locate request was addressed.

memberMac.description: Normalized targeted Virtual Chassis member MAC; omitted when no member was specified.

deviceType.description: Device family determined from its statistics before sending the command.

persistent.description: True for an AP, whose locating state persists until stopped; false for a timed switch request.

FunctionOutput_juniper_mist_locatedevice.description: Acknowledged LED locate request and its effective persistence, duration, and member target.

tags.instructions: Use this for physical identification, not network geolocation. Obtain the site and device IDs with `list-site-device-statistics`; inspect the device with `get-site-device-statistics` if needed. For a Virtual Chassis member, obtain its MAC from the device's inventory or Mist UI. AP blinking persists until stopped through Mist; this tool does not stop it. Switch blinking defaults to 5 minutes and can last 1–120 minutes. Only one Virtual Chassis member can blink at a time, so this may replace another member's locating state.
